title: Gatekeeper: Experiment Milestones for Progressive Model Rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Plan and acceptance criteria for a standardized experiment workflow (A/B tests, canaries, progressive rollouts with gates) for model-serving changes. Goals: 1) codify gates that prevent harmful regressions during model or runtime changes; 2) ensure experiments surface both quality and infra regressions; 3) provide a reproducible evaluation milestone cadence for PM/Eng/Design reviews. Scope: hosted and dedicated serving paths initially; private deployment will be handled in a follow-up ticket. Deliverables: Confluence runbook, CI/CD checklist, automated eval harness integration, monitoring dashboards and alert rules, rollout playbook for on-call and SRE.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A canary job template exists that runs automated evals + infra health checks and outputs a pass/fail gate. 2) Gate thresholds documented and enforced in the rollout pipeline: error-rate delta <= +1.5pp, P95 latency regression <= +10%, throughput degradation <= 7%, eval semantic score delta >= -0.03 embedding-similarity (normalized). 3) An A/B experiment template in the console that captures metric wiring (latency, errors, quality, token-cost) and persists results for 14 days. 4) Playbook validated in tabletop run and sign-off from SRE, Applied ML, and Legal (if required).
